title: Diverging Weather Patterns
scenario: Find cities whose temperature deviation from the annual mean has tripled in the last year compared to the historical average.
tableSchema: weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC)
correctQuery: SELECT city_name FROM (SELECT city_name, STDDEV(temp_c) FILTER (WHERE reading_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year') as last_year_sd, STDDEV(temp_c) FILTER (WHERE reading_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year') as hist_sd FROM weather_data GROUP BY city_name) t WHERE last_year_sd > 3 * hist_sd;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC);
